name: Roster Review Bench
blurb: Workshop tool, not a game region: a content-review instrument that renders every character JSON as a live dialogue card — portraits with initials fallback, faction framing, greeting/bark/radio lines cycled on a timer, the real DialogueBox and HUD radio ticker driven through the game store, plus audits that flag missing art and thin line sheets with a dashed ghost frame and a shape marker. Anchors and center live outside the playable map.
